card.name: Time units in monitoring schedules
card.fires_on: Time-period words such as year, months or years right after a number or 'the first', when a schedule of monitoring or dosing over treatment time is being given.

modes.label: After 'the first'
modes.description: The word year or months follows 'the first' in a schedule for tests or dosing.
modes.example: every four weeks through the first<< year>> and quarterly thereafter.

modes.label: After a number
modes.description: Months or years follows a count in a monitoring interval or treatment length.
modes.example: monitor fasting glucose at least once a week for 2<< months>>, followed by once every 2 weeks

card.plain: It lights up on the length of time (year, months) in schedules saying how long or how often to check or give something.
